title: Project belongs to cluster, not process; per-cluster project pointers enable multi-monitor workflows
context: Single global project prevented two windows on two monitors from showing two different projects simultaneously.
decision: Move project ownership from process to cluster. Cluster.project is the authority. Each cluster can point to its own project.
consequences: Two windows can work on different projects. Broadcast includes cluster id; relay filters events by cluster so Files in other clusters ignore project changes.
